observed_bottleneck: Algorithm Node n-010ddcf7cfac consumed all 300 oracle calls on each seed-0 objective, but deco_hop produced no formal task score because run synchronously began processing the final budget-zero observe before reading the evaluator's queued stop. Its log ends after all ten generation-29 terminal-provenance records and lacks the generation-29 gflownet_feedback and gflownet_shutdown receipts, whereas the four successful tasks completed the same terminal six-update block, emitted both receipts, and exited directly; the remaining failure is therefore the terminal replay work consuming the five-second stop grace before the repaired direct-exit path can activate.
hypothesis: Admit and receipt the terminal oracle-scored trajectories without scheduling the six post-budget trajectory-balance replay updates that cannot affect another proposal, then consume the already queued stop and execute the existing shutdown and direct exit before the evaluator grace expires, while preserving every learning update that influences later graph constructions.
method_thesis: Learn a task-agnostic forward and backward molecular-construction policy from the allowed unlabeled corpus using an atom-and-fragment graph grammar, then restart that policy independently for each objective. From an empty graph, the forward policy samples chemically valid attachment, bond, and stop actions until it produces a terminal molecule; whole corpus molecules are never retrieved, ranked, or used as a finite candidate pool. After each evaluator-announced batch is scored, map each observed score to a strictly positive tempered terminal reward and train on only oracle-evaluated molecules and their sampled construction/deconstruction trajectories using the trajectory-balance loss, a learned partition function, and reward-prioritized replay. Because trajectory balance assigns terminal probability according to total flow across every construction route rather than merely increasing the likelihood of one elite sequence, online feedback amortizes search into a de novo sampler whose probability mass concentrates on high-reward molecular regions while continuing to expose distinct routes to rare high-scoring structures. The optimization target remains the mean final Top-1 across the five independent sessions; flow statistics and replay usage are mechanism evidence, not substitute objectives.
